title: Sample questions and sample answers
author: 64cf7168c6edd65797781320
chapter_outcomes: Students will be able to demonstrate understanding of specific factual information alongside implied meaning.
Students will be able to identify the main ideas and detailed facts within a text of approximately 550–600 words.
Students will be able to analyze and understand attitudes or opinions expressed by the writer.
Students will be able to evaluate three given options to select the most accurate letter for a multiple-choice answer.
Students will be able to infer the overall attitude, gist, or general opinion of the writer when it is not explicitly stated.
Students will be able to find supporting evidence within a text to validate or eliminate multiple-choice options.
Students will be able to differentiate between literal facts and the author’s subjective viewpoints.
Students will be able to summarize the overarching theme or conclusion of a continuous reading passage.
